title: Fix workspace installation and Python 3.14 startup; qualify Phase 1 on macOS and Linux.
body:
Example-targeted installs could omit or remove Plato, and fresh Python 3.14 startup failed without a current event loop. This change makes workspace installs reproducible and client/server startup execute scheduled work with explicit loop ownership and failure propagation.

- Track `uv.lock`, refresh tested dependency bounds, and link all 15 workspace examples to local Plato. Separate base, test/dev, build/docs/audit and optional profiles; SSL and Lighteval require separate environments.
- Keep Python 3.13 as default/minimum, with tested core 3.14 forward compatibility.
- Enforce test prerequisites and exact omissions, restore fixture state after exceptions, and preserve focused pytest selections. Run bounded Ubuntu CPU jobs with separate environments and retained logs.

Phase 1 validation and publication are complete: independent reviews, the [phase gate](https://github.com/TL-System/plato/blob/maintenance/2026-refresh-audit/evidence/2026-refresh/phase1-gate.json), [root macOS validation](https://github.com/TL-System/plato/blob/maintenance/2026-refresh-audit/evidence/2026-refresh/phase1-integration-validation.json) and both [Ubuntu jobs](https://github.com/TL-System/plato/actions/runs/37082986642) passed. The [Linux evidence](https://github.com/TL-System/plato/blob/maintenance/2026-refresh-audit/evidence/2026-refresh/phase1-linux-validation.json) confirms the CI merge tree equals pushed head `beee985b`.

| Platform / Python | Base | Mandatory |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS 3.13.16 / 3.14.8, each | 246 passed; 4 skip reports | 298 passed; 1 skip |
| Ubuntu 3.13.15 / 3.14.7, each | 246 passed; 4 skip reports | 250 core + 48 runtime passed; 1 skip |

All 48 startup cases execute without skips. Mandatory runs DP/MPC and initialized Nanochat training; only the absent native tokenizer skips. Base omissions represent two DP and three Nanochat nodes. Actual CPU socket rounds train separate clients on 2/6 samples; independently recomputed weighted references match received payloads and aggregates. Clients exit naturally; five expected containment cases per interpreter leave no survivors. Cooperative finalization is tested separately from watchdog termination.

Locked installs, Ruff and typing classification checks pass; local wheel/sdist builds pass and wheel runtime sources match. Typing retains 404 classified diagnostics. Focused-selection and clean-output checker corrections are resolved.

The authorized uv NLTK 3.10.3 override retains Lighteval's metadata conflict and unsuppressed PYSEC-2026-3740 / CVE-2026-81726 advisory. Tested BLEU/ROUGE pass; ordinary wheel/sdist resolution selects 3.9.1 without that override.

Core bug fixes, MLX, example/backend qualification, archives and docs remain later phases. ViT archival replaces repair; legacy archival is authorized. No files have moved.

current_validation.delivery_summary: Phase 1 is complete: accepted 1A/1B/1C, independent phase gate, root integration/full validation, PR publication and both Ubuntu jobs passed. PR #417 is open; later phases remain pending. Root will apply this factual description update to the PR.
current_validation.environment: Apple Silicon macOS 27.0: Python 3.13.16 and 3.14.8. Published Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 CPU jobs: Python 3.13.15 and 3.14.7, uv 0.12.22. Python default/minimum remains 3.13; qualified 3.14 scope is core forward compatibility.
current_validation.warnings: Zero pytest warnings in each fresh mandatory/base run; no fork-warning suppression.
current_validation.skip_contract: Mandatory permits only absent callable rustbpe.Tokenizer for its named round-trip test; DP/MPC and both initialized Nanochat trainer tests execute. Four base skip reports represent two DP nodes in one module plus three Nanochat nodes. Base partitions out 48 startup cases; full mandatory executes them all.
current_validation.runtime: macOS and Linux each execute 48 runtime cases per interpreter. Actual socket rounds train separate clients on 2/6 samples; independently recomputed weighted aggregates match received tensors. Both clients return naturally; five expected watchdog containments per interpreter, no live owned survivors. Linux upload aliases are deduplicated to 48 unique result records.
current_validation.lifecycle_boundary: Production success retains os._exit; separate cooperative tests cover finalization. Forced containment does not prove graceful cleanup or original-error delivery from noncooperative extension code.
current_validation.static_and_artifacts: Locked sync/lock checks, Ruff and workflow typing classification pass locally and in both Ubuntu jobs. Local wheel/sdist build and diff check pass; wheel plato/client.py and plato/servers/base.py match integrated runtime sources. Typing remains nonzero with 404 classified messages on both platforms.
current_validation.review_corrections: P1C-R01 and P1C-R02 independently resolved: ordinary focused selections retain pytest behavior while explicit profiles enforce qualification; typing checker accepts verified clean output and classified nonzero output while rejecting malformed/tool-failure/unexpected-owned diagnostics.
current_validation.coverage: Not recollected by root. Retained 1C mandatory-core coverage is about 43.30% on each interpreter, excluding startup subprocesses. Comparable 219 unchanged files improved from 44.175% to 44.965%; raw baseline/final denominators differ.
current_validation.dependency_exception: Authorized workspace uv override uses NLTK 3.10.3 against Lighteval 3.9.1 metadata. Expected metadata-check failure and PYSEC-2026-3740 / CVE-2026-81726 remain visible; no published fix in retained audit. Tested metrics do not qualify arbitrary tasks. Ordinary wheel/sdist resolution selects 3.9.1 without the override; optional artifact contents depend on submodule initialization.
current_validation.evidence_boundary: Fresh root full suites establish macOS results. Published Ubuntu jobs establish Linux results on the recorded patch versions; merge checkout tree exactly matches published beee985b head. Phase 1 is complete, while optional-backend/research-family qualification and later-phase repairs remain pending. PR remains open; merge is not claimed.
current_validation.later_phases: Core correctness fixes, MLX, research example/backend qualification, coherent ViT/legacy archives and documentation remain pending. No archive moves have occurred.
